entry: MediaStepSwitch.init(target, options)  // target = the pinned stage el or selector (default '#pin'); the engine BUILDS the two full-bleed layers + the four text moments + chrome into it. options all optional. (alias: mediaStepSwitch(target, options))
rules: A PINNED full-bleed MEDIA STEPPER: the full-bleed render/video is the WHOLE background; typographic text steps float OVER it. owns_pin is TRUE.

each step is a DIFFERENT text TYPE (BIG STATEMENT / VIDEO BEAT / QUOTE / NUMBER-FACT), NOT a uniform benefit 1-2-3 card; each .moment has its own font/scale/position and enters from its OWN direction (transform-only)
the sequence WEAVES photos with a looping VIDEO beat (the river clip = the emotional centre)

CLEAN SEQUENCE per beat: the TEXT settles FIRST -> a clear PAUSE -> THEN the media crossfades; the outgoing text fades FULLY out before the incoming reads => exactly one text moment at a time (no ghost double-exposure)

SWAP = an OPACITY crossfade of TWO stacked full-bleed GPU layers (A=even parity, B=odd): outgoing underneath FULLY OPAQUE the whole beat, incoming on top fades 0->1; same rect => a crossfade, never a seam/diptych, never a blank. NOT a clip-path on a decoding video (that tanks fps).
the lite video (renders/clip-river-lite.mp4) lives in layer B; layer B holds an poster AND the

GPU smoothness: every .layer is its OWN compositor layer (will-change:transform,opacity; transform:translateZ(0); backface-visibility:hidden); animate ONLY opacity (swap) + transform (a tiny monotonic ken-burns) => layers never repaint on the main thread

NO backdrop-filter ANYWHERE over the moving media; NO clip-path on the full-screen surface; NO mix-blend over the scrubbed surface; the text blocks have NO live blur (only text-shadow). The grade + side scrim live in ONE shared overlay above both layers.
QUANTIZED DOM writes with skip-unchanged caches (round opacity/x/y/scale and write only when changed); eager img.decode() up front so no decode spikes happen during the scroll
ONE smoother: Lenis 1.1.13 lerp 0.09 (heavier glide) smoothWheel -> gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; lagSmoothing(0); no raw native scrub
render(prog) is a PURE fn of progress driven from the scrubbed ScrollTrigger onUpdate + render(0) at init; reverse-safe, correct on load/jump
PINNED stage, scrub:1, GENEROUS pin length = innerHeight*(N-1)*pinFactor so the per-frame delta is tiny
transform / opacity ONLY — no WebGL, no mask-composite, no video.currentTime
reduced-motion / <=820px => static legible stack (no Lenis, no pin, no triggers): a vertical deck of the four shots (the video autoplays inline)

steps.meaning: the sequence [{media, video, poster, el, type, enter{x,y}, objPos, title, sub}]; used ONLY to BUILD the stage when the target is empty; else the faithful msw4a 4-step photo->VIDEO->quote->number deck (DEFAULT_STEPS). Step index 1 is the lite river VIDEO.

lerp.meaning: Lenis smoothing of the scroll (heavier glide than the 0.1 default of pin-less techniques)

pinFactor.meaning: pin length factor: end = innerHeight*(N-1)*pinFactor; bigger = a longer, calmer scrub with a tinier per-frame delta

dwell.meaning: the scroll fraction over which all N-1 beats play; the last step has landed by this point so the pin releases on a settled frame

wipeStart.meaning: within a beat (f 0..1) the media crossfade OPENS here, after a long matched hold of the current step

wipeEnd.meaning: within a beat the media crossfade CLOSES here; a TIGHT [wipeStart,wipeEnd] window means the two full-bleed layers only co-composite briefly

kenStep.meaning: ken-burns growth across the whole pin (scale = kenFrom + kenStep*progress); slow, continuous, monotonic, never resets

manageLenis.meaning: true = the component owns Lenis + gsap.ticker -> ScrollTrigger.update; false = the caller already runs the smoother (one Lenis per page) and the component only wires its pinned trigger
